lines.text: When the abomination of desolation stands in the holy place, those in Judea should flee to the mountains.
Jesus says to pray that their flight will not occur in the summer or on the Sabbath.
False Christs and false prophets will perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if possible.
The Son of Man will come like lightning, and will send out His prophets with a trumpet call.
When the fig tree sprouts leaves, you know summer is near, and His words will never pass away.
